name: rmcollab
description: Real-time collaboration platform with pluggable media enhancement

scripts.scale: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d --scale gateway=2 --scale text-worker=3
scripts.test: npm run test:gateway && npm run test:client && npm run check:contracts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && tsc --noEmit -p shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p gateway/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p legacy/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p client/tsconfig.json
scripts.check:notes-replicas: docker cp scripts/notes-cross-replica.mjs rmcollab-gateway-1:/app/gateway/notes-cross-replica.mjs && docker exec -w /app/gateway rmcollab-gateway-1 node notes-cross-replica.mjs
